name: Filters
pages: Many components have a small square GUI for a {b}filter slot{/} on it, which is highlighted when looking at it. You can place an item or {i}filter{/} in these slots to specify what the component will accept as an {!}input{/} or {!}output{/}.{pb}Some components, such as a {i}smart chute{/}, also allow a {!}quantity{/} to be set to limit its output.

pages.text: {i}List filters{/} can be set with {b}specific items{/} by dragging the item from your {l:user_interface/inventory/}inventory{/l} or {l:user_interface/jei/}JEI{/l} to the {i}filter's{/} GUI. These can be used to combine multiple {i}list{/} or {i}attribute filters{/} too. The {i}filter{/} can be set as an {b}allow-list{/} or a {b}deny-list{/}.

{i}Attribute filters{/} check for {b}item properties{/} instead of particular items. These properties can include what {!}mod{/} an item is from, any {!}tags{/} it has, or what {!}type{/} of item it is. Drag an item into the {i}filter{/} to choose which properties to check for (you can select more than one).

{i}Package filters{/} can be set with a {l:logistics/packages/}package address{/l}, only allowing packages through which match that address.{pb}{i}Package filters{/} can also make use of {!}simplified RegEx{/}, to match multiple possible addresses (see next page).

pages.title: RegEx Symbols
pages.text: {b}*{/} - A wildcard that matches any character(s). Ex: "{b}a*{/}" will match any address starting with "{b}a{/}", and "{b}*b{/}" will match any ending with "{b}b{/}".{pb}{b}?{/} - Any single character. Ex: "{b}p?t{/}" would match "{b}pat{/}", "{b}pot{/}", or "{b}pit{/}", but not "{b}pout{/}".{pb}Building on this, "{b}???*{/}" would match any address with at least 3 characters.

pages: {b}[ ]{/} - Any one of the enclosed characters. Ex: "{b}p[ao]t{/}" would match "{b}pat{/}" or "{b}pot{/}".{pb}{b}[! ]{/} - Any character {!}except{/} those enclosed. Ex: "{b}p[!ao]t{/}" would match "{b}pit{/}", but not "{b}pat{/}" or "{b}pot{/}".{pb}{b}{ }{/} - Any one of the enclosed words, separated by commas. Ex: "{b}{pat,pot}-123{/}" would match either "{b}pat-123{/}" or "{b}po-123t{/}".
